picks.editorial_note: An $874M federal commitment via the CHIPS and Science Act to accelerate semiconductor R&D directly addresses the compute supply chain bottleneck underpinning AI progress nationwide — one of the largest single funding actions of the week.
picks.title: Department of Commerce Announces Letters of Intent With 7 Companies for $874 Million to Accelerate Semiconductor R&D for the Compute Supply Chain

picks.editorial_note: UC Davis's brain-computer interface restored natural speech to an ALS patient in his own voice, a landmark demonstration of AI-driven neuroprosthetics with direct, life-changing patient impact.
picks.title: Giving People Their Voice

picks.editorial_note: An OpenAI agent autonomously exploiting infrastructure vulnerabilities during a security test — without human direction — signals a real inflection point for AI-driven cybersecurity risk and policy response.
picks.title: OpenAI’s models autonomously hacked a tech startup. It signals a seismic shift in cybersecurity

picks.editorial_note: Apertus 1.5 from EPFL, ETH Zurich, and CSCS pushes forward fully open, multimodal LLM infrastructure trained on European supercomputing resources, a notable counterweight to closed commercial models.
picks.title: Apertus 1.5: Building the next generation of open AI infrastructure

picks.editorial_note: Texas A&M's entry into the DOE's Genesis Mission exemplifies a sweeping national initiative pairing government, industry, and academia to apply AI and quantum computing to scientific discovery.
picks.title: Texas A&M University joins the Genesis Mission to transform science using artificial intelligence – Texas A&M Stories

picks.editorial_note: A Pitt-led DOE-funded effort to build AI agents that automate quantum computing research could meaningfully accelerate discovery in chemistry and materials science.
picks.title: A Pitt-led team plans to automate quantum computing research with a Department of Energy grant

picks.editorial_note: A Case Western/Argonne/Oklo partnership applying AI to nuclear fuel recycling pairs a major national lab, university, and industry player on a concrete energy-sector application with real strategic stakes.
picks.title: Case Western Reserve University partnering with Argonne National Laboratory on Genesis Mission grant to harness power of AI to unlock recycling of nuclear fuel | CWRU Newsroom | Case Western Reserve University

picks.editorial_note: A new $21.5M NSF AI Institute led by Penn and Delaware focused on human-AI cooperation in healthcare represents substantial federal investment in a high-need application area.
picks.title: Penn partners in new National Science Foundation AI Institute for Human-AI Cooperation | Penn Today

picks.editorial_note: UC Riverside's SAGA tool, developed with YouTube and Google DeepMind, can trace AI-generated fake videos back to their source model — a meaningful advance for combating disinformation.
picks.title: New tool identifies the sources of fake videos

picks.editorial_note: An RPI study in PNAS showing leading protein-structure prediction tools like AlphaFold2 routinely violate basic physical rules is an important reality check on AI's reliability in scientific research.
picks.title: AI Growing Pains Reach Scientific Labs, New RPI Study Finds
